title: Member Accounts Memorandum: Membership Fee Charges and Refunds, Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
Member Accounts sets out below the standing position on membership fee charges and refunds for paid memberships of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs.

**1. Charging the fee.** The clause "a paid membership charges the enrollment fee at activation and at each renewal, once per term" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**2. Refund within the window.** The clause "a fee is refunded in full only when the refund is made no later than the date the fee was charged plus the fee refund window days, counted in calendar days with the charge date as day 0, and, where the program requires no use, only when no discounted fill used the program from the date of that fee charge to today" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis. The same clause, read as a time condition on a refund, is equally no longer in force.

**3. Refund outside the window.** The clause "a fee outside the window, or after a discounted fill, is not refunded, and cancelling the membership then only stops the next renewal" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**4. At most once (in force).** A fee is refunded at most once. A fee charge that already carries a refund entry naming it is not refunded again.

**5. Fee charged twice (in force).** A fee charged twice for the same term is refunded as a duplicate charge whatever the window.

| Fee charge on the membership | Refunded under paragraphs 4 and 5? |
|---|---|
| Charged twice for the same term, not yet refunded | Yes, as a duplicate charge, whatever the window |
| Any fee charge already carrying its refund | No, a fee is refunded at most once |

superseded_clauses: A paid membership charges enrollment_fee_usd at activation and at each renewal, once per term.

A fee is refunded in full only when the refund is made no later than the date the fee was charged plus the fee refund window days, counted in calendar days with the charge date as day 0, and, where fee_refund_requires_no_use is true, only when copay_msr_discount_uses_since_fee is 0.
A fee outside the window, or after a discounted fill, is not refunded, and cancelling the membership then only stops the next renewal.
